title: Example Import Test
description: This is an example test that demonstrates the JSON import format

questions.passageText:
This is where the passage text goes. It can be multiple paragraphs and should contain the content that questions will reference.

Second paragraph of the passage would go here.
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.explanation: The explanation that will be shown after the test. Explain why the correct answer is correct and why other options are incorrect.

questions.prompt:
Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

The researchers _______ their findings at the conference last week.
questions.explanation: Past tense is required here because the action occurred 'last week'. 'Presented' is the correct past tense form.

questions.prompt: If x + 5 = 12, what is the value of 2x?
questions.explanation: Solving x + 5 = 12: subtract 5 from both sides to get x = 7. Then 2x = 2(7) = 14.

questions.passageText: A store sells notebooks for $3 each and pens for $1.50 each. Maria bought some notebooks and pens and spent exactly $15.
questions.prompt: If Maria bought 3 notebooks, how many pens did she buy?
questions.explanation: 3 notebooks cost 3 × $3 = $9. Remaining amount: $15 - $9 = $6. Number of pens: $6 ÷ $1.50 = 4 pens.
